about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. Eight Proofline tasks, XC-39 to XC-46, one per check built after the v1.5 addendum that no signed task covers: R16a, R22, R23, R24, C1, C2, C3 and F12. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. A task becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. XC-38 is left for R20c, which is proposed on its own. Each task has the shape of XC-21: the TypeScript criteria use the signed name guard from XC-17-AC01, with the name anchored to the check id and a minimum equal to the passing tests at the commit that adds the check, so a control or a faulty build can't be dropped later without failing the task. Requirement ids reuse R-DELIV and R-CONC where a signed task already has them, and are R-<check id> for a new kind of check, as R-F11 and R-R11 are.

tasks.title: R16a: an unpaid HEAD on a paid GET route gets the same 402 as GET
tasks.description: An unpaid HEAD request on a paid GET route is answered 402: the paywall covers every method that reaches the protected handler, so a paywall that matches only GET does not let HEAD through. RFC 9110 9.3.2: HEAD is GET without the content.

criteria.statement: R16a passes a paywall that covers HEAD and catches one that matches only GET, on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia (6 passing tests named R16a)

verifier.cmd: o=$(mktemp) && { cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^R16a ' dist/test/*.test.js; } > "$o" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$o"; test "$rc" = 0 && node -e 'const[f,p,k]=process.argv.slice(1),re=new RegExp(p),min=+(k||1);let n=0,bad=0,cur=0;const fin=()=>{n+=cur;cur=0};for(const l of require("fs").readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n")){const m=/^ *(not )?ok \d+ - (.*)$/.exec(l);if(m){fin();if(m[1])bad++;else if(!/ # (SKIP|TODO)\b/.test(m[2])&&re.test(m[2]))cur=1;continue}if(/^ *type: .suite.$/.test(l))cur=0}fin();console.log("guard: "+n+" passing test(s) named /"+p+"/ (need "+min+"), "+bad+" not ok");process.exit(n>=min&&!bad?0:1)' "$o" '^R16a ' 6

docs/SPEC.md has the R16a row

tasks.title: R24: a malformed payment header is a 4xx
tasks.description: A payment header that is not base64, not JSON or not an object gets 402 or 400 with a structured error, never a 5xx, a dropped connection or the content. V2 HTTP transport, Error Handling: a malformed payment payload is 400, Payment Required and Payment Failed are 402, and 500 is for the server's own failures.

tasks.title: C1: a client never treats 402 as success
